class LdapsSettingInfo:
    """Represents LDAPS settings information for a directory."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        """Initialize LDAPS settings."""
        self.ldaps_status = "Disabled"
        self.ldaps_status_reason = None
        self.last_updated_date_time = unix_time()

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return a dict representation of LDAPS settings."""
        result = {
            "LDAPSStatus": self.ldaps_status,
            "LastUpdatedDateTime": self.last_updated_date_time,
        }
        if self.ldaps_status_reason:
            result["LDAPSStatusReason"] = self.ldaps_status_reason
        return result


class Trust(BaseModel):
    """Represents a trust relationship with another domain."""
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        directory_id: str,
        remote_domain_name: str,
        trust_password: str,
        trust_direction: str,
        trust_type: str,
        conditional_forwarder_ip_addrs: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        selective_auth: Optional[str] = None,
    ):
        """Initialize a trust relationship."""
        self.trust_id = f"t-{mock_random.get_random_hex(10)}"
        self.directory_id = directory_id
        self.remote_domain_name = remote_domain_name
        self.trust_password = trust_password  # Not returned in API responses
        self.trust_direction = trust_direction
        self.trust_type = trust_type
        self.conditional_forwarder_ip_addrs = conditional_forwarder_ip_addrs or []
        self.selective_auth = selective_auth
        self.trust_state = "Created"  # Possible values: Creating, Created, Verifying, VerifyFailed, Verified, Deleting, Deleted, Failed
        self.created_date_time = unix_time()
        self.last_updated_date_time = self.created_date_time
        self.state_last_updated_date_time = self.created_date_time

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return a dict representation of the trust relationship."""
        result = {
            "DirectoryId": self.directory_id,
            "TrustId": self.trust_id,
            "RemoteDomainName": self.remote_domain_name,
            "TrustType": self.trust_type,
            "TrustDirection": self.trust_direction,
            "TrustState": self.trust_state,
            "CreatedDateTime": self.created_date_time,
            "LastUpdatedDateTime": self.last_updated_date_time,
            "StateLastUpdatedDateTime": self.state_last_updated_date_time,
        }
        if self.conditional_forwarder_ip_addrs:
            result["ConditionalForwarderIpAddrs"] = self.conditional_forwarder_ip_addrs
        if self.selective_auth:
            result["SelectiveAuth"] = self.selective_auth
        return result
